Both responses give the correct answer, 96 km/h. The total distance is 320 km and the total time is 10/3 hours, so 320 ÷ (10/3) = 96. Both correctly explain why the simple average of 100 km/h is wrong, because more time is spent at the slower speed. Both fit under 120 words.

Response B adds the general harmonic mean formula, 2 × 80 × 120 / (80 + 120) = 96, which is correct and gives the reader a reusable rule for equal-distance legs. That addition is useful rather than padding. Response A is slightly more concise but omits this. Clarity is comparable, so B has a small edge on the key reasoning.

Verdict: B
